findings.note: Retry is “دوبارہ کوشش کریں” in about 20 ur keys, including retry_load, schedule.retry and the error copy beside this same chip, while آزمائیں means test/try out in ur catalogues (کنکشن آزمائیں، محفوظ کریں اور آزمائیں). findings.note: Here “still shown” means the preview is still visible after the image expired. ابھی leans to “right now”, while اب بھی says “still” unambiguously and matches schedule.held (ممکن ہے پچھلا شیڈول اب بھی موجود ہو).

validation.semantics: Read all 23 values against en, the context sidecar and their roles in team-bridge-attachments.tsx, team-bridge-page.tsx, team-bridge-thread-pane.tsx and team-bridge-scheduled.tsx: icon-button aria-label/title, the strip ul aria-label, chip aria-label (`${label}. ${reason}`), Spinner label, the status/alert notice paragraph, placeholder tile copy, the retry link, and the ghost Button in the reschedule dialog. Register is آپ with polite -یں imperatives throughout and no T-form; the only تو is the اگر…تو conditional in expired_staged. These terms hold against the existing file and other ur catalogues: تصویر/تصاویر (ui.canvas.files, ui.library), اپ لوڈ, منسلک (ui.chat.composer.attach_file), تنظیم (ui.teamBridge.scope.*), ہٹائیں, میعاد ختم, دستیاب نہیں, Local Operator kept Latin per glossary §1, and دوبارہ کوشش کریں in error_rate, error_quota, error_offline, error_upload, expired_staged and retry_load. Two values drift from that last term, retry and send_blocked (findings above). position/open use “{index} از {count}”, which follows ui.projects.project_updates.show_asset_name (اثاثہ {index} از {count}). The locale also uses “{count} میں سے {index}”, but از is an established, shorter form for the same positional-label role and was not raised. unsupported correctly omits the dropped “Only the text was pasted.” clause, matching the shortened en.
validation.icu: Parsed all 23 en and ur values with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser from the repo's node_modules, and the argument sets match exactly: {index}+{count} in position and open, {label} in remove and retry, plural {count} in in_message, plural {max} in limit, none elsewhere. The ur plurals carry the CLDR ur categories one/other with # inside each branch, and the count is used in the sentence. Formatted every value with intl-messageformat (locale ur) at 1, 2 and 10 (e.g. “1 تصویر”، “2 تصاویر”، “ایک پیغام کے ساتھ زیادہ سے زیادہ 10 تصاویر منسلک کی جا سکتی ہیں۔”), and all formatted cleanly. remove and retry receive the formatted position label (e.g. “تصویر 1 از 2 ہٹائیں”). The 138 base values are byte-identical to 5005cfe8b6 and the 8 replies.* values to 8913528e50.
validation.typography: All 23 values are NFC and contain no manual bidi controls (U+200E/F, U+202A–E, U+2066–9, U+061C). They use Urdu ۔ and ،, with no ASCII sentence punctuation, Hindi danda or ASCII '...'. The ellipsis in uploading is U+2026, and digits come from the formatter in Latin form per the style guide. error_type keeps the format names Latin (PNG، JPEG، WebP یا GIF); the Arabic commas between Latin tokens resolve as neutrals inside one LTR run, so the list order is preserved. Code outside the catalogue joins the chip and placeholder aria-labels with a hard-coded ASCII “. ” separator. That separator is not a catalogue defect and is not counted; it is noted for the implementer.
